blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS Settings (visionOS 26 Settings, 600x600 spatial): Single column grouped table over live passthrough (saturate 1.6 blur 28-34 + rim light, not synthetic charcoal). Statusbar 44h time + battery + muted dot only, no subtitle duplication. Header 'Settings' 22/800 -0.03 SF Pro Display + subtitle single line 11/600 ink-60 with time tabular only via font-variant-numeric — never literal token string. Search field 36h 999r 14/400 placeholder ink-40 + single ⌘K 10/700 pill right, blur8 glass. Groups are 3-4 max visible at rest (Optics, Gestures, Privacy) with 18r cards saturate1.4 blur22 + stroke 0.12 + feathered shadow 12/28 + ::after sheen 0.04, each head single label 11/700 0.12em uppercase ink-60 + count 10/700 ink-40 + 1px line 0.06 — no pill competing. Rows 56h icon 32r 10r continuity 5.5 with muted 0.07 outline or single accent gradient per group, title 14/600 ink-100 + sub 11/400 ink-60 1-line, value 11/600 tabular accent 999r, chevron 20r 0.06 subtle only on nav rows, toggle 51x31 native switch with 2.5px focus ring. Exactly one slider per viewport focus: brightness or dwell, not three stacked (Brightness lives in Display detail, dwell in Gestures detail). At any moment exactly one row is focal: others dim to 0.42, focal scales 1.02 + 2.5px stroke-focus + 22px bloom + 350ms dwell prism-ease interruptible by look-away reverse 180ms. Tapping Display pushes detail sheet var(--mat-sheet) 0.82 blur34 sliding 260ms prism-ease over passthrough with header back 34 + Done gradient + preview 112h live scrim filter tied to actual world dim + single slider 6h fill accent + auto toggle that disables track to 0.42 without literal duplication. Scroll is not needed for glance: viewport gap10 + peek 2.5 cards with depth scale 0.96 + blur falloff, single exchange peeking. Motion all 260ms prism-ease, no infinite shimmer beyond loading skeleton 1.2s tied to fetch, reduced-motion collapses to 160ms crossfade. At arm's length <1s glance: title -> search -> first group label -> first row icon -> done. Typography 3 sizes per card max (22/14/11/10), SF Pro Text 0.01 tracking, tabular only via class. Edge states are native sheets over passthrough with one 64 illustration + one CTA. Delight is one earned moment: display brightness preview glass reflects actual world dim value no extra pulse.

biggestGap: Typography dev-token leak — literal string 'tabular' shipped as user-facing content in 4 subsystem labels: expected visionOS optical hierarchy (SF Pro Display 22/800 + Text 14/600 + 11/500 + 10/700, tabular variant via font-variant-numeric tabular-nums only, subtitle reads 'Prism OS 1.0 · 68% brightness' + time tabular, row sub reads 'World scrim opacity' never '· tabular'). Got components/11-settings/index.html:710 `subtitle.innerHTML = '... brightness · tabular'` renders 'brightness · tabular' visible reviews/probe-11-round1/stage.png top 199px; :775 `World scrim opacity · tabular` visible mid 408px; :822 `Gaze hold to activate · tabular ms` visible 718px; :890 `System · spatial mix · tabular` visible 1268px. visionOS would never ship variable names; forces ~1.6s re-parse (is 'tabular' a mode? filter?). Fix: delete all 4 literal ' · tabular'/' · tabular ms' strings, keep class="tabular" for tabular-nums styling only, audit grep 'tabular' count 4 -> 0 literal, limit subtitle to 'Prism OS 1.0 · 68% brightness' + percent tabular-nums class.

gaps.glanceability: Expected <1s extraction: visionOS shows title + search + 3 groups peeking 2.5 cards depth 0.96 blur falloff, single exchange peeking, subtitle single line time tabular. Got dense infinite scroll: header 22 title + 11 pill 'Prism OS 1.0 · 68% brightness · tabular' literal duplicate + Reset/Done 28h competing + search 36h + ⌘K pill + 5 groups (Optics 4 + Gestures 3 + Privacy 3 + Audio 3 + System 3 =16 rows) stacked gap10 sh 1392 needs 836px scroll (2.5 viewports), each group head same 11/700 + count 10 tabular + line 0.06 no peeking, each card 18r same mat-glass intensity, 3 sliders inline (Brightness 136h + Dwell 135h + Volume 135h) stacked competing for glance. visionOS would peek 2.5 cards max with depth, not 5 full opaque stacks. Needs ~2.4s to find World dim toggle at 590px below fold. Fix: move 2 sliders into detail sheets (only detail keeps them), limit viewport to 3 groups max peeking + depth falloff, single primary Done only.

Got 36 focusables (30 in-stage + 6 dev chips outside) with 30-stop tab order: header Reset 61w + Done 57w + search-field 662w + Display nav 662w 64h + Brightness range 634w 32h nested inside slider-row focusable 662w (double focusable row+input), Night toggle 59x36 nested inside set-row focusable double, same for World dim, Dwell range nested inside slider-row double, Haptics/Temple/Mic/Location/Spatial/Mono toggles nested double, Lens nav, Volume nested double, About/Storage/Reset navs. At rest reviews/probe-11-round1/11-edge-normal.png zero elements dimmed, 5 cards equal mat-glass+blur22+shadow, +Done gradient same weight as value pills 11/700 accent, gaze-focus only via hover rgba0.08 + outline 2px transient not idle halo, sweep 20 steps gave no persistent bloom.
